# Situation-to-rule index

Discovery prompts, not rules summaries. Headings below were checked in the local books. Search the named heading, read its parent context and dependencies, and cite the book itself when answering. The status of a candidate must be verified before use; listed options are not automatically adopted.

Book abbreviations and file links are in [the skill](../SKILL.md). Section names are more durable than line numbers. This index is deliberately selective: search the books for anything not listed.

## Guardrails for tempting matches

- **Chases are not just combat movement:** verify their Dash/exhaustion, opportunity attack, escape and complication procedures together.
- **Expert is a sidekick class, not a generic NPC template:** check the base CR, ability to speak a language, starting level and class feature levels. Existing campaign builds still win.
- **Social interaction is not mind control:** read attitudes, risks and the limits of what a creature will do.
- **New horror penalties are not automatically in effect:** fear, stress, injuries and similar systems require a table-fit check and a DM adoption decision.
- **Creature lore is not automatically campaign lore:** read actual traits, then check campaign overrides. In particular, do not replace Barovian lycanthropy or sunlight rules with generic MM assumptions.
- **A spell name is not its full effect:** verify targeting, components, casting time, concentration, duration, saves and restrictions.
